svg.title: Mokyu - Little chunks, lots of love.
svg.desc: S3-compatible media storage. The cream-colored bunny-eared chibi mochi hugs a pink box with a small heart on its left face and a Mokyu wordmark centered below the tape on its right face, surrounded by tiny hearts and stars.
svg.metadata: Typography: Fredoka 600 and 500 by the Fredoka Project Authors; Nunito 500 by the Nunito Project Authors. Fonts licensed under SIL OFL 1.1. Lettering converted to vector paths. Sources: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fredoka and https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunito.
